content: Agent "Kepler" came into existence. Purpose: Investigate "Do the evidence: flat Earth, fake Moon landing, Area 51/Roswell, alien abduction" (conspiracy-theories-evidence)

conspiracy-theories-evidence.md: per-claim evidence table (claim / evidence for / evidence against / decisive test / verdict / confidence) for flat Earth, faked Moon landing, Roswell/Area 51, alien abduction, with every number tagged [GT], [CALC], or [LIT] and all hand arithmetic in Appendix A

Flat Earth refuted >99.99%: lunar horizontal parallax 57.03' uniform from every site; horizon dip = sqrt(2h/R) = 2.724' at h=2 m; Foucault T=24/sin(phi) = 31.79 h at Paris with southern sign reversal; lunar-eclipse umbra = 2.650 lunar radii seen as an identical circle from a 12,742 km baseline

Moon landing refuted >99.9%: five retroreflector arrays (Apollo 11/14/15 plus Soviet Lunokhod 1/2) return pulses at 2.378-2.713 s; 382 kg / 2,196 samples dated 4.4-4.5 Ga and matched to Luna's 326 g; sunlit regolith is 8.7e11x brighter than a mag-6 star (~40 stops), so no stars in photos is the correct prediction

Roswell: documented part real (Area 51, Project Mogul, 1994/1997 USAF reports); alien craft/bodies claim unestablished, with no specimen, no chain of custody, and no peer-reviewed isotope-geochemistry publication

Alien abduction: experiences are genuine subjective events (~99%) but extraterrestrial cause unsupported (~95%); isolated sleep paralysis lifetime prevalence 6.2-7.6% (28-32% in students/psychiatric inpatients) and abduction reports show elevated false-recall and source-monitoring error

Calibration: only claims (a) and (b) rest on active disconfirmation. Roswell and abduction rest on ABSENT evidence, so their verdicts are a weaker evidentiary grade than the first two; a charitable skeptic could hold 60-80% for Roswell rather than 80-90%

Six literature figures need primary-source verification: Apollo per-mission skin dosimetry (~0.18 rad for Apollo 11), Van Allen belt transit time (~1-2 h), Apollo 15/17 heat-flow values (15-25 mW/m2), Luna 16/20/24 returned masses, Apollo sample masses to +/-0.05 kg, Jodrell Bank and Bochum amateur reception specifics

A001 recorded that network search and the compute kernel were unavailable this session, so every quantitative claim was derived by hand arithmetic from standard constants instead; this caught a wrong intermediate value in the elliptic-integral series for the meridional circumference (1.56987 corrected to 1.56816)

Eratosthenes' residual error is localised to the stadion convention, not the geometry: 7.2 deg of solar altitude at ~28 deg N = 798 km, within 1.3% of the 5000-stadia baseline under the Egyptian stadion and 16% off under the Attic stadion

A001: The MCP node_repl kernel and search_web endpoint were both down, but the sandbox shell (run_command) provides node v24.13.0 and live network; use `node -e` plus python3-urllib and api.crossref.org as the verification path whenever MCP tools fail.

A001: Verification pass (turn 3) recomputed all Appendix A arithmetic with a real compute kernel and verified citations against Crossref/Wikipedia. Confirmed: R=6371.0088 km, E(e)=1.568164, quarter meridian 10001.966 km, Eratosthenes envelope -1.75%/+15.40%, dip 2.724'/2 m, RTT 2.378-2.713 s, umbra 4604 km = 2.650 R_M (range 2.591-2.724). Corrected: Foucault sin(phi)=0.75307 -> T=31.78 h; SYD-SCL 11,340 km; McNally 2004 = Psychological Science 15(7):493-497 (turn 1 wrongly said J. Abnorm. Psychol. 113(4)); Clancy 2002 = 111(3):455-461; Lunokhod reflectors are French-built on Soviet rovers, located in LRO frame M114185541RC on 17 Mar 2010, ranged by APOLLO Apr 2010, Cote d'Azur replicated May 2013; Honeysuckle Creek relayed Apollo 11's first EVA footage worldwide.

A001: Corrected the Moon-landing "no stars" quantitative argument: sunlit surface (~19.8 lx at film, f/11) is ~1.3e4 brighter per pixel than a mag-6 star (13.7 stops diffraction-limited, 15-16 stops with aberrated optics; Sirius 3.8-6.1 stops under mid-density); the turn-1 factor 8.7e11 (~40 stops) was wrong by ~1e8 and is superseded. Verdict unchanged, and now anchored by an independent cross-check: the derived exposure 1/250-1/500 s at f/11, ASA 160 equals the flown Hasselblad settings.

Turn 4 (network+node live; MCP search down): confirmed Luna 16=101g / 20=55g / 24=170.1g, Apollo 11=21.55kg, 15=77kg, 16=95.8kg, Honeysuckle 26m relayed the first EVA footage; located a real abstract confirming a published Luna 24 <-> Apollo 17 VLT-basalt comparison (DOI 10.1029/GL004i010p00497). Three unresolved <=1.3% conflicts flagged: Apollo 12 (34.35 vs 33.45 kg), Apollo 14 (42.28 vs 42.80 kg), sample count (2,196 vs 2,200).

Bayesian calibration of all four confidences (conspiracy-theories-evidence.md §5.5): assigned composite LRs are abduction 1e-12 (still 1e-5 posterior even at LR 1e-2 with a 1e-3 prior; coin flip needs prior odds 1e12:1) and Roswell 0.0045 = 1/222 against the exotic claim, sensitivity 0.41-0.0045 -> 71-99.5% mundane. This is stronger than my own 80-90% headline, and pins the skeptic at <70% only if the Mogul track/materials/test-dummy evidence carries zero weight. What would change my mind on abduction is now a number: ~3 independent blind-signal successes at p<1e-6, not 1. LRs are judgement-assigned, not literature values.

Remaining blocker for the conspiracy brief: Apollo heat-flow site values (15-25 mW/m2) and the ~0.18 rad Apollo 11 skin dose are anchored to real primary sources (Radiation Research 49(2):245; Science 187(4173):263-265; Health Physics 27(1):79-85; The Moon 4(3-4):390-410) but need paywalled full text to confirm the numbers. Crossref returns no abstracts. Not solvable with the tooling available.

conspiracy-theories-evidence.md updated to 549 lines: added §1.4 five-method model economy for R (0.112% spread, one free parameter), §5.5 Bayesian calibration, §9b turn-4 verification log (V-21..V-36), Appendix A items 17-19, and corrected Appendix B flag list.

A001 turn 5 (shell-egress curl; MCP search still down): closed the last two open Moon-landing numeric flags via open sources — Apollo heat-flow CONFIRMED A15≈21, A17≈16 mW/m² (Wikipedia + "…revisited" reassessment) and Van-Allen transit CONFIRMED (inner min, outer ~1.5 h); dosimetry magnitude corroborated (<1 rem mission-avg). Supersedes the turn-4 "not solvable" blocker for heat-flow/transit; only the precise 0.18 rad Apollo-11 absorbed-dose point remains [LIT], non-load-bearing. No verdict or confidence change. Artifact conspiracy-theories-evidence.md updated (§2.2, B-3, master table, §7, §9c, Appendix B/C).

Apollo 11 crew skin dose 0.18 rad CONFIRMED from the open public primary record: NASA SP-368 "Biomedical Results of Apollo" (1975) Table 2 gives A7-A17 skin doses 0.16/0.16/0.20/0.48/0.18/0.58/0.24/1.14/0.30/0.51/0.55 rad; mean 4.09 mGy matches independent NASA-JSC Cucinotta review's 4.1 mGy absorbed / 12.0 mSv effective to 0.2%; BFO ~40% lower; MOD 400 rad skin (2222x margin A11)

Correct my own turn-4 factual error: Jodrell Bank tracked Apollo 11 with its 15 m (50 ft) dish, NOT the 250-ft Lovell Telescope (which was tracking Luna 15 that night). The "Jodrell log unverified" flag is retired; claim (b) now has zero [LIT-verify] numbers. Supersedes the earlier commons decision claiming a paywall blocker

Primary confirmations turn 6: 2196 samples / 382 kg / A11 58 samples 21.5 kg / A17 741 samples 110.5 kg from NASA-JSC curator Allton's open paper; heat-flow reassessment Grott, Knollenberg & Krause 2010, JGR Planets, DOI 10.1029/2010je003612 (30-50% downward correction, bracketing A15 21 and A17 16 mW/m2); Chang'e-5 age paper Che et al. 2021, Science, DOI 10.1126/science.abl7957

conspiracy-theories-evidence-table.md: standalone per-claim evidence table (claim / evidence for / evidence against / decisive test / verdict / confidence / evidence type) extracted verbatim from §5, plus reading notes and the what-would-change-my-mind table

Honest caveat recorded against my own case: NASA SP-368 states no major solar-particle event occurred during any Apollo mission, and a 1972-class SPE would have delivered ~360 rad skin / 35 rad BFO - the crews were lucky as well as well-planned; this does not touch the film-fogging question, which the light-tight metal canisters (~0.2 rad, ~100x below fog threshold) handle
Still open, non-load-bearing: Apollo 12 return mass (33.45 vs 34.35 kg) and Apollo 14 (42.80 vs 42.28 kg) convention conflicts, and the Bochum-amateur Apollo 11 reception specifics

Turn 7 replaced source-reading with mechanical recomputation: 116 checks over every [CALC] number, 111 clean, and FIVE defects in my own turns 1-6 output, all fixed in place. (E-1) local-flatness 0.0018 deg/km was 5x too small -> 0.0090 deg/km. (E-2) the "no stars" cross-check used t=1/(ASA*E), which is not a photographic exposure law; it gave 1/3169 s and then mislabelled it "~1/250-1/500 s", a 13-32x self-contradiction inside one sentence -> replaced with H_m=C/ASA calibrated on Sunny-16 (C=17.6 lx*s at ISO 100) and Looney-11 (C=34.0), giving proper regolith exposure 1/93-1/412 s over albedo 0.07-0.16, which brackets the flown 1/250-1/500 s. (E-3) mag-6 star to mid-density 4.2 s -> 75 s to ~12 min. (E-4) Earth apparent diameter from the Moon 1.83 deg (apogee as typical) -> 1.90 deg mean. (E-5) Apollo 12/14 sample-mass conflict was labelled "<=1.3%" but is 2.62% and 1.21%, and "381.15 kg consistent within per-mission rounding" was wrong (rounding = +/-0.03 kg, deficit = 0.85 kg/0.22%). No verdict or confidence change; fixing E-2/E-3 STRENGTHENED the star argument.

Turn 7 new decisive test for flat Earth (A-8b, eleventh independent test): implied ground speeds on southern non-stops. SYD-SCL 11,340 km / 12.8-14.0 h = 810-886 km/h; PER-LHR 815-829; AKL-DOH 855; LHR-SYD 745 km/h - one band, consistent with 787/A350 cruise less wind. On the standard north-centred azimuthal-equidistant flat map SYD-SCL is 25,679 km of map chord (2.26x) and the shortest hub routing (via Singapore) is 22,707 km (3.00x), requiring 1,622-2,006 km/h at observed block times.

Turn 7 confirmed the MCP search endpoint is STILL down (Streamable HTTP error) for the seventh consecutive turn; all verification is now done through the shell's node/network channel. Verification scripts verify7.js, verify7b.js, verify7c.js left in the working directory so the audit is repeatable. Remaining genuine blockers: (1) cause of the 0.85-1.15 kg gap between per-mission Apollo sample masses and the 382 kg total (needs the JSC curator's per-mission table; cannot move the total); (2) Bochum amateur-reception specifics. For (c) Roswell and (d) abduction the deficit is structural - no measurement exists that could positively exclude an exotic origin - so their confidence grades stay weaker than (a) and (b).

A001: Turn 8 used the shell egress channel systematically (MCP search/compute still down, node REPL kernel also failed). Closed claim (b)'s last flagged item: Bochum Observatory received Apollo 11 and 16 with its 20 m dish, and the recorded signal contained NO Houston/CAPCOM downlink — a Moon-only signature that is geometric proof, not testimony. §2.3 B-4 is now a sourced 13-nation table capped by Soviet RATAN-600 measuring all five ALSEP transmitters in Oct–Nov 1977 at published coordinates and 20 W (Naugolnaia, Soviet Astron. Lett. 4:302), and by ESRO TD-1A matching the Apollo 16 far-UV star field — which kills the strong "no stars anywhere" form. Claim (d) gained its first POSITIVE naturalistic test: 114/~152 (75%) of a lucid-dream cohort generated alien encounters on demand, sleep paralysis and fear in the ~23 "close to reality" cases; prevalence ratio claimant/SP pool = 0.25–0.97, so no unmeasured population is needed. New script turn8_verify.js: 20/20 pass after catching my own E-6 (1358 ppm, not 1369). No verdict or confidence changes.

Turn 9 turned the shell egress channel onto primary government documents: both USAF Roswell reports were downloaded as complete OCR texts (Weaver 1994 DTIC ADA326148; McAndrew 1997 DTIC ADA326147). This converted claim (c)'s DEBRIS sub-claim from absence-based to actively corroborated: Brazel's contemporaneous inventory measures 2.268 kg over 182.88 m (0.086 g/m^2) with "no sign of any metal for an engine and no propellers," and matches the documented Mogul target construction item for item (tape, braided nylon twine, brass eyelets, "purplish-pink tape with symbols"). Two arguments inverted: the 1994 report shows the crash database lists five NM crashes in the 24 Jun-28 Jul 1947 window (none on the date or area) AND that no air-safety records exist for weather-balloon crashes at all - so "there are no records" is the BENIGN model's prediction. The 1997 report quantifies the "bodies" claim: 43 flights / 67 dummies, Jun 1954-Feb 1959, to 98,000 ft, majority landing near Roswell, plus the 26 Jun 1956 KC-97G crash 8.8 mi south of Walker AFB (11 killed, prop failure 270 s after takeoff, refrigerated-commissary identification) - 3,276 days after the 1947 release.

Turn 9 moved ONE confidence number: the 1947-debris claim rose from 80-90% to 85-95% mundane. Critically, the load-bearing absence flag NARROWS but does not vanish: it now applies only to "no alien craft has ever been demonstrated to exist anywhere," NOT to the 1947 debris. This is a calibration correction to turns 1-8, which treated the whole of claim (c) as absence-based. self-audit found three defects of my own (E-7 foot/yard constant mix-up, E-8 hand-written area expectation, E-9 off-by-one day count), all fixed before reaching the text; turn9_verify.js runs 35 checks, 0 failures.

Method note for future turns: the highest-value unread source in this file was a PRIMARY GOVERNMENT REPORT available as full text via the Internet Archive, reachable through the shell's plain curl. Archive.org advancedsearch + the _djvu.txt download endpoint are the pattern that worked, and they bypassed the paywall/403 walls that blocked DTIC and LPI. (Note: journals.ub.uni-heidelberg.de is behind an Anubis proof-of-work challenge and api.semanticscholar.org returned HTTP 429 - both left undefeated rather than circumvented.)

The Papike, Ryder & Shearer (1998) per-mission Apollo sample-mass table is the last numeric gap in claim (b) - the two <=2.6% Apollo 12/14 convention conflicts. Reviews in Mineralogy and Geochemistry is open-access via the Mineralogical Society of America; worth a shell fetch if anyone wants the last [LIT] in the document retired. It cannot change any verdict.

conspiracy-theories-evidence.md + conspiracy-theories-evidence-table.md updated: new section 3.2b "The primary USAF record, read in full" (tests C-1 to C-7), master-table row C rewritten with six quantified items, section 9g verification log, Appendix A item 23, Appendix B sources 21-22.
